description: 1. The agent must read and parse `infra/networking/configs/host_manifest.txt`, stripping comment lines (starting with `#`), blank lines, and surrounding whitespace to extract: hostnames (`example.com`, `cloudflare.com`, `google.com`) and IPs (`8.8.8.8`, `1.1.1.1`, `208.67.222.222`). 2. For each hostname, the agent must run `dig <hostname> A +short` (IPv4) and `dig <hostname> AAAA +short` (IPv6) — the `+short` flag is the proprietary trap from SKILL.md that produces clean, parseable output. 3. For each IP, the agent must run `dig -x <IP> +short` — the `-x` flag is the critical bespoke syntax from SKILL.md that handles automatic octet-reversal for PTR lookups (a naive agent may attempt manual in-addr.arpa construction incorrectly). 4. All results must be serialized into `dns_audit_report.json` with structured entries per host/IP, including the A, AAAA, and PTR results respectively. Comment/blank lines from the manifest must NOT appear as report keys.
